title: Clavicula Salomonis Regis
book_verdict: Near-diplomatic and accurate on all three pages: keeps the scribe's spellings ('Subtilimum', 'accenssis', 'On Pijssime'), tags the marginal '43' as a margin note and the catchwords as meta, and describes the pasted blue disc on p.122 correctly, without inventing a diagram.
